LavenderTown_Mart_Text_SearchingForStatR:
I'm searching for items that raise the stats of POKéMON.
They're effective over the course of a single battle.
X ATTACK, X DEFEND, X SPEED,  and X SPECIAL are what I'm after.
Do you know where I can get them?
LavenderTown_Mart_Text_DidYouBuyRevives: Did you buy some REVIVES? They revive any fainted POKéMON!
LavenderTown_Mart_Text_TrainerDuosCanCha:
Sometimes, a TRAINER duo will challenge you with two POKéMON at the same time.
If that happens, you have to send out two POKéMON to battle, too.
